results.answer: Assumptions: Population is current adjudications of the payer named Medicare Part B North Carolina with paid_amount > 0. Average is the mean claim-level paid amount, in dollars rounded to 2 decimals. Result: 1 rows: [[111.0]]
results.final_sql: SELECT round(avg(paid_amount), 2) AS avg_payment FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount > 0 AND payer_name = 'Medicare Part B North Carolina'

results.answer: Assumptions: Lag is days from the date of service on the earliest 837 to that earliest submission date, any payer. Primary payer class is the class on the latest submission with payer_responsibility P. Voided claims stay in. Median is unrounded; average is rounded to 2 decimals. Result: 7 rows: [['blues', 83, 4.95, 4.0, 0], ['commercial', 154, 8.6, 4.0, 1], ['medicaid', 11, 11.09, 3.0, 0]]
results.final_sql: WITH submissions AS ( SELECT claim_key, submission_date, service_date_from, payer_class, payer_responsibility FROM sem.claims ), first_any AS ( SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission, arg_min(service_date_from, submission_date) AS service_date FROM submissions GROUP BY claim_key ), primary_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, arg_max(payer_class, submission_date) AS payer_class FROM submissions WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key ), lags AS ( SELECT p.payer_class, date_diff('day', f.service_date, f.first_submission) AS lag_days FROM first_any f JOIN primary_payer p USING (claim_key) ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS claims, round(avg(lag_days), 2) AS avg_lag_days, median(lag_days) AS median_lag_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lag_days > 90) AS submitted_after_90_days FROM lags GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

results.answer: Assumptions: Fraction of current-adjudication service-line paid dollars whose submitted procedure code is G0483, as a 0-1 ratio rounded to 4 decimals. Result: 1 rows: [[0.041]]
results.final_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS fraction_of_paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

results.answer: Assumptions: Each frequency-7 837 submission is one corrected replacement. Month is the submission month. Charge is that submission's claim charge. Result: 1 rows: [['2026-07-01', 10, 7343.23]]
results.final_sql: SELECT submission_month, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS replacement_claims, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Assumptions: Days to pay is the current adjudication payment date minus the first 837 submission date to that same primary payer, only where paid > 0. Median and 90th percentile use linear interpolation and are rounded to 1 decimal. Result: 6 rows: [['blues', 12, 16.0, 19.0], ['commercial', 20, 14.0, 16.3], ['medicaid_mco', 1, 20.0, 20.0], ['medicare', 3, 18.0, 18.8], ['medicare_advantage', 9, 14.0, 19.2], ['other', 1, -11.0, -11.0]]
results.final_sql: WITH primary_sub AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS first_submission FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), paid AS ( SELECT s.payer_class, date_diff('day', s.first_submission, r.payment_date) AS days_to_pay FROM primary_sub s JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = s.claim_key AND r.payer_key = s.payer_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0 ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims, round(median(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days, round(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days FROM paid GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

results.answer: Assumptions: Denied means the current adjudication is_denied. A code counts only when it is a reviewed denial CARC in group CO on that current adjudication. Each claim+payer counts once per code. Top 5 by pair count, CARC ascending on ties. Result: 5 rows: [['18', 4], ['11', 2], ['16', 2], ['22', 2], ['96', 2]]
results.final_sql: SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT r.claim_key || '|' || r.payer_key) AS denied_pairs FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.adjustments a ON a.remit_claim_id = r.remit_claim_id WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

results.answer: Assumptions: Denial rate is denied current adjudications over current adjudications for payer_class medicaid_mco, one row per claim+payer, reported as a 0-1 ratio rounded to 4 decimals. Result: 1 rows: [[0.0196]]
results.final_sql: SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_class = 'medicaid_mco'

results.answer: Assumptions: A remitted pair is any claim+payer with at least one 835 event. First pass means exactly one event, and that event is the current adjudication and is not denied. Rate is a percent rounded to 2 decimals. Result: 7 rows: [['blues', 93, 85, 91.4], ['commercial', 139, 130, 93.53], ['medicaid', 16, 15, 93.75]]
results.final_sql: WITH events AS ( SELECT payer_class, claim_payer_key, count(*) AS n_events, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS current_not_denied FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY payer_class, claim_payer_key ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) AS first_pass_resolved, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct FROM events GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

results.answer: Assumptions: Population is current adjudications that are denied. CARCs are CO-group reviewed denial codes on those adjudications, claim or line level. Pair count is distinct claim+payer; dollars are the sum of those CO amounts. Result: 12 rows: [['18', 4, 1931.26], ['11', 2, 432.49], ['16', 2, 7325.03]]
results.final_sql: SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT r.claim_key || '|' || r.payer_key) AS denied_pairs, round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2) AS co_amount FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.adjustments a ON a.remit_claim_id = r.remit_claim_id WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY denied_pairs DESC, a.carc_code

results.answer: Assumptions: One row per claim at the latest submission, voids included. A procedure's denominator is distinct claims with that billed code. The top principal diagnosis is the mode, tie-broken by lowest diagnosis code. Share is a percent to 1 decimal. Result: 188 rows: [['36415', 'Z0000', 31, 224, 13.8], ['80048', 'D649', 1, 5, 20.0], ['80053', 'Z0000', 34, 179, 19.0]]
results.final_sql: WITH latest_lines AS ( SELECT c.claim_key, c.principal_diagnosis_code AS dx, l.procedure_code FROM sem.claims c JOIN sem.claim_lines l ON l.claim_id = c.claim_id WHERE c.is_latest_submission ), by_dx AS ( SELECT procedure_code, dx, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS claims_with_dx FROM latest_lines WHERE dx IS NOT NULL AND procedure_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY procedure_code, dx ), totals AS ( SELECT procedure_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS claims_with_procedure FROM latest_lines WHERE procedure_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY procedure_code ), ranked AS ( SELECT procedure_code, dx, claims_with_dx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_code ORDER BY claims_with_dx DESC, dx ASC) AS rk FROM by_dx ) SELECT r.procedure_code, r.dx AS principal_diagnosis, r.claims_with_dx, t.claims_with_procedure, round(100.0 * r.claims_with_dx / nullif(t.claims_with_procedure, 0), 1) AS share_pct FROM ranked r JOIN totals t USING (procedure_code) WHERE r.rk = 1 ORDER BY r.procedure_code

results.answer: Assumptions: Overall denial rate is denied current adjudications divided by current adjudications, one claim once per payer, as a 0-1 ratio rounded to 4 decimals. Result: 1 rows: [[0.0427]]
results.final_sql: SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication

results.answer: Assumptions: A trace is check_or_eft_number. Pairs with two or more distinct traces are counted by payer class. No current adjudication means no is_current_adjudication row. Paid is the current adjudication paid amount, else 0. Result: 2 rows: [['blues', 3, 2, 0, 180.33], ['commercial', 2, 0, 0, 84.34]]
results.final_sql: WITH pairs AS ( SELECT payer_class, claim_payer_key, count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS traces, bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current, sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) AS current_paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY payer_class, claim_payer_key HAVING count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) >= 2 ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS pairs_with_no_current, round(coalesce(sum(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM pairs GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

results.answer: Assumptions: One row per claim at the latest submission, voids included. Line count is the claim header line_count. Share of claims is a percent to 1 decimal. Average charge is the mean claim charge. Result: 16 rows: [[1, 108, 21.1, 637.5], [2, 72, 14.1, 543.23], [3, 38, 7.4, 388.29]]
results.final_sql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission ), tot AS ( SELECT count(*) AS n_claims FROM latest ) SELECT l.line_count, count(*) AS claims, round(100.0 * count(*) / nullif(max(t.n_claims), 0), 1) AS share_pct, round(avg(l.charge_amount), 2) AS avg_billed FROM latest l CROSS JOIN tot t GROUP BY l.line_count ORDER BY l.line_count

results.answer: Assumptions: A partial denial is a current-adjudication 835 service line with line_is_denied on a claim whose current adjudication is not denied. Result: 1 rows: [[36]]
results.final_sql: SELECT count(*) AS partial_denied_lines FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

results.answer: Assumptions: Deductible is the sum of current-adjudication PR adjustments with CARC 1. Primary means the 837 payer_responsibility is P for that claim+payer, not the 835 payer_sequence. Result: 1 rows: [[297.24]]
results.final_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P') SELECT coalesce(round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2), 0) AS primary_deductible FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN p ON p.claim_key = a.claim_key AND p.payer_key = a.payer_key WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'

results.answer: Assumptions: Grain is the current adjudication, so primary and secondary both count. Missing patient responsibility is 0. Percents are paid/PR divided by 835 claim charge, on a 0-100 scale to 1 decimal. Result: 7 rows: [['blues', 93, 54300.18, 8913.43, 2575.5, 16.4, 4.7], ['commercial', 139, 60892.64, 12307.41, 3733.54, 20.2, 6.1], ['medicaid', 16, 6291.01, 1082.27, 0.0, 17.2, 0.0]]
results.final_sql: SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS current_adjudications, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed, round(sum(paid_amount), 2) AS paid, round(sum(coalesce(patient_responsibility_amount, 0)), 2) AS patient_responsibility, round(100.0 * sum(paid_amount) / nullif(sum(charge_amount), 0), 1) AS paid_pct_of_billed, round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(patient_responsibility_amount, 0)) / nullif(sum(charge_amount), 0), 1) AS pr_pct_of_billed FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.final_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS voided_claims FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8'

results.answer: Assumptions: One claim per latest submission from service month June 2026 on, voids included. Top 5 referring NPIs by claim count, NPI ascending on ties. Claims with no referring NPI stay in the month total and out of the ranking. Result: 2 rows: [['2026-06-01', 114, 21, 18.4], ['2026-07-01', 377, 44, 11.7]]
results.final_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, claim_key FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01' ), totals AS ( SELECT service_month, count(*) AS total_claims FROM base GROUP BY service_month ), by_npi AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS n FROM base WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi ), ranked AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi ASC) AS rk FROM by_npi ), top5 AS ( SELECT service_month, sum(n) AS top5_claims FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY service_month ) SELECT t.service_month, t.total_claims, coalesce(x.top5_claims, 0) AS top5_claims, round(100.0 * coalesce(x.top5_claims, 0) / nullif(t.total_claims, 0), 1) AS top5_share_pct FROM totals t LEFT JOIN top5 x USING (service_month) ORDER BY t.service_month

results.answer: Assumptions: Primary payer is the latest 837 with payer_responsibility P. Each such claim counts once, voids included. Percents use that primary-claim population as the denominator, on a 0-100 scale to 1 decimal. Result: 7 rows: [['blues', 83, 17.0, 47177.45, 18.9], ['commercial', 154, 31.6, 64272.19, 25.7], ['medicaid', 11, 2.3, 4307.18, 1.7]]
results.final_sql: WITH primary_submissions AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount, submission_date, claim_id FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ), latest_primary AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount FROM ( SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) AS rk FROM primary_submissions ) s WHERE rk = 1 ), tot AS ( SELECT count(*) AS n_claims, sum(charge_amount) AS billed FROM latest_primary ) SELECT p.payer_class, count(*) AS claims, round(100.0 * count(*) / nullif(max(t.n_claims), 0), 1) AS claims_pct, round(sum(p.charge_amount), 2) AS billed, round(100.0 * sum(p.charge_amount) / nullif(max(t.billed), 0), 1) AS billed_pct FROM latest_primary p CROSS JOIN tot t GROUP BY p.payer_class ORDER BY p.payer_class
